name: Recreation Leader in Training (RIT), ages 13 to 15
what_you_do: This is a mentoring and job-readiness program for 13 to 15 year olds. Teens help with park programs. Programs include sports, games, nature and arts and crafts. You build leadership, communication and customer service skills.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 15 who live in Chicago.
pay_detail: The program page does not mention pay or a stipend. Confirm with the Park District before you plan around pay.
duration: Spring, fall and winter: 8 weeks, 6 hours a week. Summer: 6 weeks, 30 program days.
deadline_text: 2026 sessions: Winter Jan 12 to Mar 14 (programs viewable online Dec 1, 2025), Spring Apr 6 to Jun 6, Summer Jun 22 to Jul 31, Fall Oct 5 to Dec 11 (viewable online July 27). 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Contact the staff at the park you are interested in to start the application. The process is an application, an interview, a mentoring curriculum and performance check-ins.
notes: Re-read on 2026-10-09: ages 13 to 15, Chicago residence, the apply step (contact the park) and the 2026 session dates all match the page. The page says RIT is a job readiness program and participants are not Park District staff. It does not mention pay, so the pay type was changed from stipend to no pay stated. The next sessions are posted online about a month before each starts.
